metadata.case_name: YIP LEUNG HOI v. TIN WO ENGINEERING CO LTD AND OTHERS

injuries.description: small medial meniscus tear and swollen anterior cruciate ligament at his left knee joint.
source: It shown mild left knee effusion, small medial meniscus tear and swollen anterior cruciate ligament at his left knee joint.
injuries.icd_description: Injury to multiple structures of knee

injuries.description: There was tenderness and decrease in range of movement of left shoulder.
source: There was tenderness and decrease in range of movement of left shoulder.
it is my finding that while the Plaintiff may have sustained injury at his left shoulder, it was fully recovered soon after the 2nd Accident.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of shoulder joint

injuries.description: avulsion fracture of right distal tibia.
source: He had a slip and fall on 7 November 2003 and suffered from an avulsion fracture of right distal tibia.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the ankle or foot

manifestations.description: the Plaintiff walked with a walking stick with a limping gait
walking tolerance without walking stick was 3 minutes and with stick was 11 minutes
the Plaintiff had difficult in walking up and down stairs/slope due to persistent bilateral knee pain especially on the left side

Persistent bilateral knee pain; such pain is pulsatile in character and is fluctuating in intensity. The left knee is more severe than the right side. There is resting pain and the pain increased with standing and walking.
Right ankle pain on weight bearing since right ankle sprain injury in late November 2003.
Persistent left shoulder pain which is more severe than the knee pain. It disturbs his sleep.
Numbness over the whole of left upper limb and ulnar half of right and index fingers.
On and off neck pain for about a year. It increases with movement.
Pain over left scapular and upper back.
Have to use stick for ambulation due to knee pain.
Walking tolerance is 10 minutes with the aid of a stick.
limitation of neck movement, left shoulder joint movement and left knee joints movement

treatments_received: physiotherapy (23 sessions commencing 15 February 2002, last treatment 5 July 2002)

losses.description: walking tolerance without walking stick was 3 minutes and with stick was 11 minutes; difficulty in walking up and down stairs/slope; could not squat

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Cannot carry weights; cannot climb stairs; cannot squat

unable to cope with his pre-accident job which required manual lifting of steel bars, continuous standing of 4 hours, continuous squatting of about half an hour, climbing up and down and bilateral pulling and pushing of steel bar against bar bending machine of force about 60 – 80 lbs
